quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Operating ROIC normalized to 35.0% cap reflecting Avanza's ultra-capital-light digital banking model (capex < 3% of earnings, SEK 13.1B cash/central bank deposits vs SEK 356M debt, and ROE 35-50%). Peak Owner EPS of SEK 16.81 is driven by record platform savings capital. Forward compound growth of 8.5% (g_implied) is driven by net savings inflows (7.0%), occupational pension share gains (1.5%), and operating leverage (0.5%), offset by rate normalization (-0.5%).
